interface.description: Network interface to monitor initially. Use 'auto' for the first active interface.

sampling_interval.description: Sampling interval in seconds for network traffic updates.

scrolling_interval.description: Scrolling interval in seconds for the graph display.

lock_mode.description: If true, wmifs will not switch to the next available interface automatically.

waveform_mode.description: If true, use waveform graph mode instead of the classic bar graph.

color.description: Color string for the graph display (e.g., green, blue, red).
